svg.text: Wearable Agent Kit · Local single-user architecture
Local, single-user · synthetic by default · one provider per live run
Local TTY authorization. Encrypted vault; plaintext checkpoint. WHOOP official OAuth/API; Garmin unofficial Connect.
Current CLI wiring only. Summaries return to the caller. Authorization alone is not live-data acceptance.
